usedFor: HubSpot events, such as “New Invoice Created”, start sales opportunities in Sangam CRM through “Create Opportunity”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Due” in HubSpot, then “Create Opportunity” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A due HubSpot task carries its details, and the action creates an opportunity with a next follow-up date.

watchOut: “New Task Due” is polling, so the opportunity in Sangam CRM appears on a schedule after the task falls due.
